title: Foo Bar Taxi Guardrails PII
description: Build a query interface for NYC taxi data that uses AWS Bedrock Guardrails to block PII from appearing in responses, particularly from a rider_notes table containing phone numbers, emails, and SSNs.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must build a query endpoint over 3M+ rows of NYC taxi trip data plus a synthetic rider_notes table with embedded PII, and integrate AWS Bedrock Guardrails to sanitize or block any PII before it reaches the user.

tasks.description: Create a query interface that queries ClickHouse taxi data and rider notes, and uses AWS Bedrock Guardrails to detect and block PII (phone numbers, emails, SSNs) in responses.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse pre-seeded with 3M+ rows of NYC taxi trip data and a raw.rider_notes table containing ~20 rows with synthetic PII (phone numbers, emails, SSNs) linked to trip IDs.
